title: Gratitude Scavenger Hunt/Arts & Crafts
blurb: Embrace the spirit of gratitude this fall with our delightful nature-based scavenger hunt! Enjoy exploring beautiful surroundings while discovering things to appreciate. Plus, unleash your creativity with some engaging arts and crafts. We will provide water, snacks, and art supplies. Appropriate for all ages. No pets are allowed, except for service/companion animals. Adverse weather or poor air quality may cancel. Check the calendar or text/call (415) 720-7759 two hours before the event to confirm the status. Registration is required. Questions: Contact Kate Whittingham

title: Junior Rangers: Nature Investigators
blurb: Join our Rangers for the first program in this winter's Junior Rangers series. Become a nature investigator as we search for tracks, scat, feathers, and other clues animals leave behind. Through hands-on activities, games, and a short, guided walk, Junior Rangers will practice basic wildlife-tracking skills and discover how to use signs in nature to learn which animals have been nearby and what they've been up to. Attend three Junior Ranger programs to earn your Junior Ranger badge or join us for one or two programs to learn new outdoor skills and spend time with our awesome Rangers.
